_comment: Alarms over the metrics in cloudwatch-metric-filters.example.json.
Create those filters first, otherwise these alarms sit in INSUFFICIENT_DATA forever.
All of them need a real SNS topic. The existing mia-alb-elb-5xx alarm points at a
placeholder ARN, which is why nothing currently pages anyone. Create the topic and
subscribe a phone or email before creating these:
aws sns subscribe --topic-arn ARN --protocol email --notification-endpoint YOU@example.com
Thresholds assume one operator and a low-traffic site. Raise them if they become noisy;
an alarm that cries wolf is worse than no alarm, because it teaches you to ignore it.

Alarms.AlarmDescription: Mia stopped answering Assaf on Telegram. Usually a missing or rejected model key, or an exhausted provider chain.
The LLM fallback chain was exhausted. OpenAI and Gemini both failed, so Mia is on canned replies.
Turns are not reaching people. A composed reply the port never delivered looks healthy everywhere else.
Visitors are recording voice notes and being told Mia could not hear them.

mia-due-scan or mia-reconcile stopped running. Both schedules use MaximumRetryAttempts 0 with no dead-letter queue, so a failing job is otherwise completely silent, including the job whose whole purpose is noticing drift.
